task_objective: Vet the fork's thirteen candidate plugin repositories with the configured audit policy and add only unique repositories whose newest eligible release is neither AUDIT_ERROR nor BLOCK.

setup.remote_dev_pull: Attempted git pull --ff-only origin dev; origin has no dev ref, so the clean local dev tip f05cc29 was used as the required base.
setup.audit_tooling: Trivy 0.73.0 and ClamAV 1.4.5 with packaged signature databases were staged under /tmp; no host packages were installed.
setup.required_scanners: Every candidate report recorded trivy=passed and clamav=passed; source-artifact-diff was passed or found_issue, and disabled Semgrep was skipped as configured.

retained_plugins.disposition: Expected root plugin deployment/restart behavior and child-environment LD_PRELOAD removal; no blocking finding.
Bundled Python dependencies/native wheels plus README deployment examples and requests/urllib3 matches; no blocking finding.
The release intentionally bundles three platform native libraries as build artifacts; no blocking finding.
pdf.js/WASM and xmltodict package metadata dominate the matches, with an explicit dependency build script and emulator mount arguments; no blocking finding.
Regex exec calls, git subprocess/environment sanitization, and explicit unverified shader-manager download contexts were reviewed; no blocking finding.
Expected root hardware-control subprocess plus README deployment commands and frontend wording matches; no blocking finding.
Expected root sysfs/HID control, README deployment commands, and vendored pyudev documentation matches; no blocking finding.
Expected user-session systemctl/subprocess operations and loader-environment sanitization; no blocking finding.
Expected sudo user-switch wrapper for NordVPN commands; no blocking finding.

excluded_plugins.reason: Already present upstream at version 1.0.1; the candidate repository's newest audited release was older at 1.0, so retaining the redundant URL failed the exact-count negative control.

verification_evidence.catalog_negative_control: Against an isolated dev catalog generated from the same live sources, stable count increased 136 to 145 and testing count increased 120 to 129, exactly +9 in both.
verification_evidence.catalog_versions: All nine retained plugin names appeared in stable and testing with at least one version.
verification_evidence.quality_gates: ruff check passed; 25 files already formatted; 219 passed and 21 subtests passed; no deleted review notes.

not_verified: Static analysis does not prove any retained plugin safe or evaluate runtime behavior.
Only each repository's newest eligible release was audited; historical releases were not audited.
